@charu.beatbox (Charu) can play the flute while beatboxing 🤯⁣
⁣
She taught herself both skills through online videos, then started blending them into something called fluteboxing.⁣
⁣
“Even if it’s not easy, with curiosity and consistency, anyone can find joy in their own unique way.”⁣
⁣
Video and music by @charu.beatbox
